method.slope: height.slope_degrees on the 129x129 vertex grid, HeightScale from setting.txt (0.5), cell 200 cm; each terrain cell's slope shared by its 2x2 attr cells
method.slope_threshold: argmax F1 of (slope >= T) as a predictor of ATTRIBUTE_BLOCK, T swept 0..80 deg
method.footprint: Chebyshev ring fill on the BLOCK mask around each areadata placement; radius = last r with ring fill >= 0.50; window 32 m; 'isolated' = no other placement within 8 m Chebyshev
method.border: band = consecutive edge rows/cols whose BLOCK fraction over valid cells is >= 0.90 (strict) / 0.50 (loose)
